name: Omazia
author: antesmd
description: Tunnel status, transactional switching, import, rename, QR export, live traffic and drop notifications in the Omarchy bar. Manages AmneziaWG tunnels under /etc/amnezia/amneziawg via awg-quick and a small root helper invoked with pkexec — no NetworkManager, no sudo shell. Unofficial third-party widget; not affiliated with the AmneziaWG project.

barWidget.description: Toggle, switch and rename AmneziaWG tunnels, import .conf files, show QR codes, watch traffic, get a toast when a tunnel drops. Drives awg-quick through a pkexec helper — no NetworkManager, one-time sudo ./install.sh for the polkit policy.
